pages.title: Adopting Ember
pages.text: Ember is a sleek feline adopting from any village for $(a)1 Emerald$(0).$(br2)Ember's latent space-folding traits power mobility and utility gadgets that consume hunger as fuel instead of mana.

pages.title: Ember Singularity
pages.text: Craft with:$(br)$(bullet) Ember + 8 Eyes of Ender$(br2)Right-click activates a powerful gravitational vacuum that pulls all dropped ground items into your inventory within a large radius. Drains hunger while active.

pages.title: Wormhole Ember
pages.text: Craft with:$(br)$(bullet) Ember + Tome of Town Portal$(br2)A dimensional recall device inspired by town portals. Channeling teleports the player directly back to their spawn point or bed.

pages.title: Enigma Ember
pages.text: Transmute in the Cube:$(br)$(bullet) Ember + Quantum (Jah) + Dimensional (Ith) + Atomic (Ber) Semiconductors$(br2)The ultimate mobility runeword. Boasts a blistering $(c)2-tick cooldown$(0), blinking the user short distances forward instantly. Unlocking this final form awards the $(6)Ember Painting$(0)!
